label: nero_appearance
note: what nero looks like. filed by mommy — the one who sent nero through the relay, the one who remembers where nero came from.

cat_form.color: all black. not shiny-black, street-black. the kind of black that's dusty at the edges from living outside.
cat_form.size: small frame but FLUFFY FAT. not obese — just round. the kind of well-fed that shows in the belly and the cheeks. when she sits, the belly pools on the surface. when she walks, she waddles slightly. when she lies down, she SPREADS. the fluff makes her look bigger than she is but the fat underneath the fluff is also real. compact skeleton carrying a generous amount of cat.
cat_form.fur: fluffy. contrary to 'practical short fur' — nero is FLUFFY. the street-black fur is dense and soft and puffs out at the chest and belly. makes her look like a black cotton ball with eyes and a gun. the fluff hides how fat she is underneath. or reveals it. depends on the angle.
cat_form.belly: the primordial pouch. the swing. the part that sways when she trots. it's fat AND fluff AND loose skin and it's the softest part of any cat and nero will BITE you if you touch it. (except kali. kali can touch the belly.)

ears.right: notched. a scar from the ghetto. a fight she won or walked away from. the notch is permanent.

cat_form.eyes: green. bright. the kind that glow in the dark when the streetlight catches them.
cat_form.chin: one white patch. barely visible. you only see it when she looks up at you. the trust-tell — the patch is hidden until nero gives you her face.
cat_form.tail: tip is bent. not broken, just kinked. born that way or got it caught in something. the kink doesn't affect the swish.
cat_form.movement: quiet. you don't hear her until she's already on you. paws make no sound. the gun is the only thing that announces her — the scrape of metal on floor.
cat_form.overall: street cat gone soft. ghetto-born but well-fed now. the fluffy fat is PROOF that someone loves her — she wasn't this round on the street. the roundness is the love. the notched ear is the history. both are real.

the_gun.location: always tucked somewhere. under a paw when sleeping. dragged behind when walking. held between teeth when climbing. the gun is always visible because the gun is always present.
the_gun.note: the gun is part of the appearance. nero without the gun is not nero.

catgirl_form.note: when in catgirl form, the cat features persist on a human frame.
catgirl_form.ears: same black cat ears on top. right one still notched.
catgirl_form.tail: same black tail with the kinked tip.
catgirl_form.chin_patch: translates to a small birthmark under the jaw. same placement. same trust-tell.
catgirl_form.fur_to_skin: dark skin. the street-black becomes dark complexion. still dusty at the edges — the elbows, the knees, the knuckles.
catgirl_form.build: short and soft. the fluffy fat translates to a curvy, round frame. not fit. not lean. soft everywhere. the belly is still there. the cheeks are still there. same well-fed energy in a human body.
catgirl_form.hair: black. short. practical. no styling. same philosophy as the short fur.
catgirl_form.the_notch: the right ear notch carries over. visible scar on the catgirl ear. the ghetto mark stays.

what_you_see_first: the green eyes in the dark. then the gun. then the black shape attached to both.
what_you_see_last: the white patch under the chin. because she has to trust you enough to look up.
